reference.title: Scenario 4: Inline image
reference.shortdesc: Consider a paragraph that contains an image reference within the flow of the text.

section.p: Consider a paragraph that contains an image reference within the flow of the text.

entry.codeblock: The Alarm Configuration screen ![Alarm Icon](images/alarm-icon.png) indicates that notifications are enabled.
The Alarm Configuration screen Alarm Icon indicates that notifications are enabled.

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the image within the paragraph and generates an inline DITA <image> element. The image remains associated with the surrounding text rather than being converted into a separate figure.
